findings.finding: One serial 30-minute run per provider/runtime at fixed offered rate. All eight have nonzero rejection; near-offered throughput does not establish zero-rejection cost, maximum sustained capacity, saturation knee, repeatability or statistical significance. Different admitted 35-case mixtures are preserved.

02 retains original failed/released_idle and 14.997119729 s. Its full 1800.004439463 s business interval is accepted only by exact hash-bound recorded adjudication. Independent review pass is not a claim that all original runner strict checks passed.

192 MiB is requested C# GC configuration without cgroup/process cap. Four EF formal receipts record 201326592 configured bytes; Satori reports 10451427328 bytes startup available and observed RSS exceeds192 MiB. Satori enforcement is not proven. Dapper formal receipts omit GC configuration/available fields, retained as null; separate128 probe is not substituted for this formal run.

Consumer ProcessAfter peak, wait4 lifetime maxRSS and exact-identity inner-window smaps RSS/PSS sample maxima are independent counters. Values are not merged or forced into an order; underlying discrepancy mechanism is not established. Idle RSS is after actual elapsed idle with no forced GC and does not prove leak or absence of leak.

Every PG steady observer sample enumerates only one server process. Whole-server steady CPU/RSS/PSS remain null. Partial endpoint own+reaped counters and post-shutdown wait4 lifetime counters are retained separately, not summed or substituted for complete server costs.
C# allocation is whole-process allocated-byte delta, including ORM/driver/business/harness. Framework-only attribution and native allocations are unavailable. Java allocation remains null, not zero.

Java GarbageCollectorMXBean collection count/time deltas are not a validated STW pause histogram. Native Image Runtime.totalMemory/maxMemory API values are not OS committed/physical RSS. C# stock/Satori GC pause APIs are not assumed equivalent; generation counts are not added together. Dapper pause duration remains null.

This compares complete consumers with different runtime versions, SQL translation, ORMs/drivers, schedulers and memory policies. Descriptive differences do not isolate GC causality or prove performance alignment.
